title: Self-Supervised Attention-Based Virtual Metrology for CMP MRR Prediction
abstract: arXiv:2611.16172v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Chemical mechanical planarization (CMP) is a critical semiconductor manufacturing process where material removal rate (MRR) is a key metric for process monitoring and advanced process control (APC). Virtual metrology enables MRR estimation from process time series signals, supporting run-to-run(R2R) control and process optimization while reducing reliance on physical metrology. Existing approaches typically rely on simplified linear assumptions or require handcrafted feature engineering. In this paper, we propose Global Regression Pretraining(GREP), a self-supervised, attention-based framework for CMP MRR prediction. GREP learns temporal representations from unlabeled sensor signals through global proxy-target regression, followed by supervised fine-tuning for MRR estimation. The framework is evaluated against a feature-engineered supervised baseline under three conditions: limited labeled data, sensor noise, and temporal process drift

translated_title: 基于自监督注意力机制的CMP材料去除率预测虚拟量测
translated_abstract: 化学机械抛光（CMP）是半导体制造中的关键工艺，其中材料去除率（MRR）是工艺监测和先进过程控制（APC）的关键指标。虚拟量测技术能够从工艺时间序列信号中估计MRR，支持逐批（R2R）控制和工艺优化，同时减少对物理量测的依赖。现有方法通常依赖简化的线性假设或需要手工特征工程。本文提出了全局回归预训练（GREP），这是一种基于注意力的自监督CMP MRR预测框架。GREP通过全局代理目标回归从未标记的传感器信号中学习时间表征，随后通过监督微调进行MRR估计。该框架在三种条件下与经过特征工程监督的基线方法进行了评估：有限的标记数据、传感器噪声和时间上的工艺漂移。
tldr: 本文提出了基于自监督注意力机制的全局回归预训练框架GREP，通过从无标签传感器信号中学习时间表征用于CMP材料去除率预测，在有限标记数据、传感器噪声和工艺漂移等挑战性条件下优于传统特征工程监督方法。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes GREP, a self-supervised attention-based pretraining framework for CMP MRR prediction that learns temporal representations from unlabeled sensor signals and outperforms feature-engineered supervised baselines under limited labels, sensor noise, and process drift.
